description: Edge diagnostics validation (attribution + healthy-baseline drift); no supervised component labels exist in C-MAPSS
evaluation_boundary: C-MAPSS provides unit-level RUL only; no per-unit component fault labels exist. Subsystem attribution is a model/physics-based explanation, not a supervised component diagnosis.

config.attribution_formula: A_c = mean_t |(x[t,c] - b[t,c]) * dRUL/dx[t,c]|, b = regime-aware healthy baseline; settings forced to 0; shares = 100*A_c/sum_c A_c
config.drift_formula: z[t,c] = (u[t,c] - mean_{t<30} u[t,c]) / sigma_healthy_c, u = per-regime standardized sensor
config.train_units: 80% of training units (split_units, val_frac=0.2, per seed)
config.single_fault_population: held-out training units (run to failure) + all official test units; windows with true RUL < 30
config.two_fault_population: all training units + test units with official RUL <= 30; profile = mean of last 10 windows
config.clustering: StandardScaler -> KMeans(k=2, n_init=10, random_state=seed); GMM(diag) agreement; clusters oriented by cosine similarity of mean signed EOL drift to the label-free HPC-only reference (FD001 for FD003, FD002 for FD004); the other cluster is the fan-mode candidate

summary.note: drift metrics are model-independent (identical across seeds); chance rates assume attribution mass proportional to sensor count per subsystem
